title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Customer Service Representative to work in the Muncie, IN area for a top utility and energy company. This position offers a variety of great benefits, including health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off.

Job Summary:

The Customer Service Representative for the New Install Process will play a critical role in managing the customer life cycle for new utility installations. This position involves guiding customers through the installation process, ensuring a seamless experience from initial inquiry to service activation.

Job Responsibilities: 
  • Act as the primary contact for customers during new installations, addressing inquiries and concerns, and providing updates throughout the process.
  • Collaborate with internal departments for timely scheduling and completion of installations, while maintaining accurate records in the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system.
  • Educate customers on utility services and energy efficiency, contributing to process improvements for enhanced satisfaction and efficiency.
  • Utilize knowledge of equipment and systems, maintaining intermediate computer literacy to perform cost-effective work.
  • Train and guide employees, adhering to company policies and fostering a cooperative environment.
  • Adjust work activities based on time constraints, seeking information to enhance job skills.
    Network with peers, contribute to team goals, and make decisions that improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to resolve customer concerns and ensure positive customer experience throughout the process.
  • Assist in scheduling jobs and planning project activities, ensuring safe working environments and effective communication of project details.
  • Other duties as assigned. 
Requirements:
  • Associate degree in Electrical, Electronic, Civil, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Business, Communications, or a related field with 4 years of related experience OR a Bachelor’s degree with 2 years of utility industry experience.
  • Previous customer service experience, preferably in the utility or service industry.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient with CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Occasional travel may be necessary, ranging from 10% to 25%. No overnight travel.

title: Technician Associate
description:

JOB SUMMARY:
  • This position utilizes DDS software to analyze distribution utility poles for the purpose of adding grid modernization equipment or line rebuilds associated with transmission and station projects.

  • Associate’s Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Civil/Mechanical Engineering Technology or related field.
  • Ability to read and understand schematic drawings.
  • Good computer software skills; quick learner

title: Engineering Technologist
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking an entry-level Engineering Technologist to work in the South Bend, IN area for a top utility and energy company. This position offers a variety of great benefits, including health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off.
 
Job Summary:

The successful candidate will be performing engineering circuit analysis studies and customer impact studies.

Responsibilities:
  • Possesses technical to entry-level knowledge acquired from a bachelor’s degree in an ABET accredited engineering technology program. Demonstrates the ability to perform with proper guidance special technical functions required in the relevant area of assignment. Gains familiarity with standards, codes, and regulations relevant to the area of assignment. Assists higher-level engineers in handling well-defined portions of routine problems.
  • Follows policies, practices, standards and rules of the company and those regulations and procedures required externally. Performs certain ongoing activities in accordance with established procedures with direction from higher level employees. Performs work activities as assigned and coached by higher level employees.
  • Maintains required records to support assignments and prepares special reports for tests, equipment performance, projects and other reports as assigned
  • Assists with providing input to annual budget, capital forecasts, five-year plan, and improvement requisitions.
  • Participates in planning meetings covering scheduling, operations, and maintenance of equipment.
  • Assists in the preparation of basic cost estimates using established guidelines.
  • Actively seeks out information and understanding of engineering problems and solution techniques applicable to area of responsibility.
  • Assists and participates in the preparation of reports and technical papers. 
  • Develops a basic understanding of utility accounting and financing.
 
Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering Technology in a program accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET). Engineering degrees will also be considered.
  • Entry level position for new graduates.
  • Valid driver's license.

title: Lead Installation Technician

Standard Field Experience:
  • Consistent Daily Reports and Communication to Management

  • Terminate all types of cable including but not limited to:
  • XLR
  • Crimp or solder control

  • Multiple manufacturer wall mount experience
  • Peerless
  • Chief

Site Safety Training – SST NYC DOB card – OSHA 40
Limited technical certifications in this role, no requirements
Field experience is mid-level to veteran

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Construction Project Manager to join our team near Anderson, SC. This Direct Hire opportunity offers a competitive compensation package along with excellent benefits, including health insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.
 
Position Summary:
The Project Manager will work closely with the Project Management Office (PMO) to define, develop, and implement project management methods, procedures, and best practices. This role ensures that all procedures are applied effectively across projects while maintaining quality, financial, and schedule targets.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with the PMO to define methods, procedures, and best practices and ensure compliance across projects.
  • Develop project scope in partnership with technical and sales teams, defining responsibilities and all other stakeholders. Utilize standard Project Management tools to manage projects efficiently.
  • Identify and secure resources to meet project objectives. Work with functional leaders to create the project organizational resource chart and a RACI matrix to clarify roles and responsibilities.
  • Coordinate across order management, production, logistics, contractors, services, and warranty groups. Escalate conflicts to prevent customer impact and balance large project demands with ongoing business operations.
  • Partner with the Site Manager (SM) to communicate schedule, budget, and scope, and periodically visit sites to build relationships with contractors, customers, and key personnel.
  • Evaluate alternative delivery methods to improve project outcomes and establish clear processes between functional areas.
  • Escalate issues promptly to ensure timely resolution, monitor team schedules, and coordinate activities along the critical path. Conduct effective meetings and presentations with stakeholders.
  • Implement project tracking, reporting, and KPIs to monitor quality, schedule, and cost. Maintain meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups.
  • Promote a culture of safety across all projects, hosting periodic safety meetings to prioritize safety at every stage.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 3–5 years of project management experience; critical infrastructure experience (UPS, thermal, battery, monitoring) is a plus
  • Knowledge of construction, electrical, and mechanical contracting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong customer service and project management skills
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational, analytical, and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to multi-task and thrive in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing processes, data center infrastructure, and commissioning processes

title: Occupational Therapist
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies is looking for a full-time permanent Occupational Therapist for a permanent 40 hour week position in a hospital based outpatient setting working with adults and some pediatrics. This role will provide full healthcare benefits, a 401k, annual profit sharing, and a base salary between 65-85k based on experience level and role fit. 

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a full-time permanent member. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives by helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life. You will work in a supportive and collaborative environment alongside a team of healthcare professionals.

  • Provide comprehensive evaluations and assessments of patients' needs.
  • Develop personalized treatment plans to address individual patient goals.
  • Collaborate with other healthcare providers to ensure coordinated care.
  • Utilize a variety of therapeutic techniques and equipment to aid patient recovery.
  • Educate patients and their families on strategies to improve daily living skills.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient progress.
